title: Effects of High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) Treatment on Fecal Continence and Anorretal Fisiology
brief_summary: Investigate the presence of hypotonic anal sphincter after anorectal dilatation and High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HiFU) , through the aplication of questionnaires and Anorectal Manometry before and after this treatment.
condition: Anal Continence After High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) Treatment
